text:
maya: Hi — just accepted the org invite and turned on 2FA. Trying to push to redwood/infrastructure but getting a permission error. Can someone peek? @jonathan @liz

jonathan: Hey! can you paste the exact `git push` output?

maya: ```
$ git push origin main
remote: Permission to redwood/infrastructure.git denied to maya-h.
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```

liz: Are you using SSH or HTTPS?

maya: SSH. `ssh -T git@github.com` returns: 'Hi maya-h! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.'

jonathan: That means your key authenticates, but might not have org SSO or the repo write permission. Two quick checks: 1) confirm you're in the infra-writing team on org -> People/Teams, 2) check the SSH key page for an SSO banner to 'Grant access to organization'.

maya: Where do I grant org access for the SSH key?

liz: GitHub -> Settings -> SSH and GPG keys -> click the key -> there should be a 'Grant access to redwood' button if SSO is enforced. Also try `gh auth status` to see if SSO is active.

jonathan: Also note some repos have separate writer group (infra-writers) vs readers. Being in infra-readers will still show the repo but you can't push. @eng-platform can check mapping.

eng-platform: Hi @maya — I checked org membership: you're currently in `infra-readers`. I'm sending an invite to `infra-writers` now. Please accept the invite and let me know.

maya: Got the invite, accepted. Trying to push again... still permission denied.

liz: Can you run `gh repo view redwood/infrastructure --json viewerPermission` and paste the value?

maya: Result shows `"viewerPermission": "READ"`.

jonathan: Hmm. Try these: 1) ensure your local remote uses the ssh URL (`git@github.com:redwood/infrastructure.git`) — `git remote -v`. 2) run `ssh -vvv git@github.com` and check which key is offered/used. 3) if SAML SSO was required, you might need to re-authorize via `gh auth login` or refresh PAT.

maya: Remote is correct. I did `ssh -vvv` — it shows my key is used and accepted. In the browser the org shows a SAML banner; I clicked 'Authorize' and it said access granted.

eng-platform: I re-synced team mappings and explicitly added your account to infra-writers on the repo ACL. Try again in ~60s.

maya: Still getting the same denied message. Also seeing a prompt in the web UI: 'Your access to this organization is limited — re-authorize SSO'. I clicked authorize again.

jonathan: After SSO authorization, `gh` sessions may still be stale. Run `gh auth login` -> choose GitHub.com -> authenticate and make sure SSO is authorized for redwood. Then try `git push` again.

maya: Ran `gh auth login` and re-authorized SSO. Push succeeded! :tada: Thank you all.

liz: Nice — glad it's working. Leaving a quick checklist here for future new-hires:
- Accept org invite and enable 2FA
- Grant org access to your SSH key if prompted (Settings -> SSH and GPG keys)
- If SAML/SSO is used, authorize the session in the browser and re-run `gh auth login` to refresh CLI tokens
- Confirm team membership (infra-writers vs infra-readers) and repo ACLs

maya: Adding to onboarding notes — appreciate the help :heart: 

eng-platform: Ping us if it happens again and we'll check team mappings and repo ACLs.
